mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.code FROM admin_permission p INNER JOIN admin_role_permission rp ON rp.permission_id = p.id INNER JOIN admin_role r ON r.id = rp.role_id INNER JOIN admin_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id INNER JOIN admin_user u ON u.id = ur.admin_id WHERE ur.admin_id = #{adminId} AND u.enabled = 1 AND r.enabled = 1 AND p.enabled = 1 ORDER BY p.code
